name: MoCCA Arts Fest
blurb: An independent and small-press comics festival presented by the Society of Illustrators at Manhattan's Metropolitan Pavilion.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'The Society of Illustrators presents MoCCA Arts Fest April 17 - 18, 2027' and 'SI MoCCA Arts Fest Hours April 17th & 18th, 2027'

notes: Current official name is 'MoCCA Arts Fest' (site title), evolved from 'MoCCA Festival'; kept the given id. No guest/lineup page exists on the site — the event is built around paid exhibitor tabling for small-press/indie creators ('Exhibitor Applications') rather than a curated celebrity/creator guest list, so guests is set to 'none'.
